create.name: Dr. Katie Hendricks
create.bio:
Dr. Katie (Kathlyn) Hendricks has spent around fifty years developing what she calls body intelligence: learning to notice sensation, breath and movement as a source of guidance in daily life and in close relationships. She holds a doctorate in transpersonal psychology and practised for decades as a certified dance and movement therapist, and with her husband Gay Hendricks she founded the Hendricks Institute in 1989. Together they have written a dozen books on conscious relationships, among them Conscious Loving, The Conscious Heart, At the Speed of Life and Conscious Loving Ever After.

Her teaching is playful and experiential. Rather than long explanation, she offers short practices, such as the Yes Breath or Fear Melters, that let people feel a shift from fear towards presence, and she leads a free practice session every Monday on the institute's YouTube channel. As the institute's director of training she shapes its online courses, such as Evolutionary Playground and the advanced body intelligence course, and over the years she has trained several hundred coaches in body awareness and relationship work across the United States and Europe. She also records the weekly be.play.love podcast with Sophie Chiche. The institute is based in Ojai, California, where it also holds in-person seminars.

books.title: At the Speed of Life: A New Approach to Personal Change Through Body-Centered Therapy
books.author: Gay Hendricks and Kathlyn Hendricks
books.description: Gay and Katie Hendricks' book on change through the body: noticing breath, posture and movement and working with feelings as they arise. The institute recommends it as reading before its body intelligence training.

courses.title: Body Intelligence Advanced Training 2027
courses.description: An eight-week online training, meeting twice a week, in ways of bringing body awareness into coaching, counselling and everyday life. It mixes recorded and live sessions with Katie and Gay Hendricks and counts towards their coaching certification.

courses.title: Evolutionary Playground: New Paths to Change for Uncertain Times, Winter/Spring 2027
courses.description: A six-week online course on living through a cycle of presence, connection and play instead of struggle and blame. Sessions run twice a week, with morning or afternoon options, and it is the first step of the institute's coaching programme.

courses.title: Essentials Online – A Self-Paced Online Seminar Available for Use at Home
courses.description: Katie's condensed version of the institute's three-day seminar: about three and a half hours of videos with a workbook, covering practices such as Fear Melters, the Yes Breath and working with personas. Self-paced, with no live sessions.

free_resources.title: The “Yes” Breath
free_resources.description: A short seated breathing practice in which the breath leads a gentle rocking of the pelvis and spine. Written instructions on the institute's site.

free_resources.title: Bodymind Centering Process
free_resources.description: A guided process for settling into the body and staying present with whatever sensations, thoughts and feelings come up. Free on the institute's site.

free_resources.title: Presence-Connect-Play App
free_resources.description: A free app from the Foundation for Conscious Living that offers a random trio of prompts for being present, connecting with others and playing. Available for phones and on the web.
